learn.text: Niels Bohr received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1922.

q: What did the scientist Niels Bohr receive the Nobel Prize for in 1922?

options.t: A method for measuring the speed of light
A model of the structure of atoms
A theory of the Earth's magnetic field

answerText: A model of the structure of atoms
appeared: It appeared in the November 2022 and June 2026 exams.

da.q: Hvad fik videnskabsmanden Niels Bohr Nobelprisen for i 1922?
options: En metode til måling af lysets hastighed

learn.text: In the 20th century the Danish physicist Niels Bohr, who lived from 1885 to 1962, achieved international fame. As a young man he set up a model of the structure of atoms. For it he received in 1922 the Nobel Prize in Physics.

q: Which Nobel Prize was Morten Meldal awarded in December 2022?

learn.text: Morten Meldal, born 1954, who is professor at the University of Copenhagen, received together with two American researchers the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2022 for having laid the foundation for the so-called click chemistry.
